title: fix(plugin-charts): keep the xAxis object on any declared presentation key (objectui#10516)
body:
Fixes #10516
Clause-②: no

Executes triage `5829695041`: `normalizeChartSchema` keeps the x-axis object whenever it carries any declared presentation key, pinned per key with `title` as the control. Implemented by the `os-dev` dispatched from seat `domain:ui#2` (claim `5829769784`), session `https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`.

## The change

The x gate in the axes block was `xAxisSpec.format || xAxisSpec.title || xAxisSpec.showGridLines !== undefined`. It now asks whether `Object.keys(xAxisSpec)` holds any key other than `field`, the data key hoisted to `xAxisKey`. The object is kept whenever `normalizeAxis` kept one.

There is no second key list. The presentation set is whatever `normalizeAxis` read, and `normalizeChartSchema.specAxisKeys-7690.test.ts` already ties that read set to the installed spec's `ChartAxisSchema` keys in both directions. The new per-key pins read their key list off `ChartAxisSchema.shape` minus `field`, so a key the spec adds joins them on the next install. No new dependency: `@objectstack/spec` stays a devDependency, and the runtime test runs over the normalized object.

## Mechanism hypotheses, measured on the base `9cbe4dbca`

- **H1: confirmed.** The gate was exactly that expression. `{ field, min, max, stepSize, logarithmic, position }` normalized to no `xAxis` (see the red rows below).
- **H2: derived**, as described above. There is no hand list and no mirrored declaration.
- **H3: different shape, left unchanged.** The y-axis branch has no presentation gate at all. Every entry `normalizeAxis` returns is kept, `{}` included, and that is what preserves the secondary-axis count.
- **H4: measured through `ChartRenderer`**, with normalizer and renderer as one path and recharts in a fixed 510x350 box, on the head:
  - `min` / `max` / `stepSize` on a scatter x axis set the bottom ticks to `0 50 100 150 200`. On the base they were `0 25 50 75 100`. This is pinned.
  - `logarithmic: true` on a scatter x axis with x = 1, 10, 100, 1000 gives mark `cx` gaps of `143 143 143`. On the base, and on the head with `false`, the gaps are `4 39 385`. This was a one-off probe and is not kept.
  - `position: 'top'` on `xAxis` leaves the tick labels at `orientation="bottom"` for both scatter and bar, on the base and on the head. The key survives normalization now, but no renderer reads it. That is reported as its own finding below and is not implemented here.
- **H5: pinned as asked.** See the table below.

## Red on base, green on head

`normalizeChartSchema.xAxisPresentationGate-10516.test.ts` (unit project) and `ChartRenderer.scatterXAxisScale-10516.test.tsx` (dom project) were first run against the unchanged base source, then against the fix.

| pin | base | head |
|---|---|---|
| the sample covers exactly the spec presentation keys | pass | pass |
| `title` alone beside `field` (the control) | pass | pass |
| `format` alone | pass | pass |
| `showGridLines` alone | pass | pass |
| `min` alone | FAIL: xAxis undefined | pass |
| `max` alone | FAIL | pass |
| `stepSize` alone | FAIL | pass |
| `logarithmic` alone | FAIL | pass |
| `position` alone | FAIL | pass |
| the card's reproduction: all five, no title | FAIL | pass |
| falsy values: `min: 0`, `logarithmic: false`, `showGridLines: false` | FAIL | pass |
| control: `field` alone yields no `xAxis` | pass | pass |
| control: refused values (`stepSize: -5`, `min: 'zero'`, `position: 'middle'`) yield no `xAxis` | pass | pass |
| seam: scatter ticks from `min` / `max` / `stepSize` with no title | FAIL: `0 25 50 75 100` | pass |
| seam control: the same axis plus `title` | pass | pass |

Totals over the two files: base `8 failed / 7 passed`, head `15 passed`.

## Files beyond the claim's surface, and why

The claim named `normalizeChartSchema.ts`, the tests beside it and one changeset. Two more files changed. Each holds a published sentence that this change makes false, and the dispatch contract says such a sentence is repaired in the same change:

- `content/docs/plugins/plugin-charts.mdx`: removed the caveat saying that on `xAxis`, `min`, `max`, `stepSize` and `logarithmic` take effect only when the object also carries `title`, `format` or `showGridLines`. That caveat described this defect. The page's 14 fenced blocks are byte-identical between base and head (sha256 prefix `84a4534a0330fcf9` on both sides).
- `packages/core/src/utils/chart-presentation.ts`: the `axisPresentation` docblock is exported, so it ships in core's `.d.ts`. It said the normalizer keeps only `format` / `title` / `showGridLines` on the x-axis. It now points at the normalizer and the new pin rather than restating an answer (AGENTS.md #9). This is a comment-only edit.

No pending changeset sentence becomes false. `9675-scatter-spec-axes` and `7113-chart-data-model` describe x-axis keys reaching the normalized axis, and this change makes that true for more axes, not fewer.

## Gates

The union was re-run at `01f7648b6`, the head of this PR. Each entry quotes the gate's own verdict line.

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-charts --filter @object-ui/core run type-check`: both packages echo `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` and end with `Done`. `--listFiles` shows both new test files inside plugin-charts' test program. The dependency closure (`@object-ui/plugin-charts^...`, 9 packages) was built first.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-charts/ packages/core/src/utils/`: `Test Files 163 passed (163)`, `Tests 2564 passed (2564)`. Full `packages/core/` at `4cc8be66f` (core's bytes have not changed since): `171 passed`, `3486 passed`. The four plugin-dashboard files that import `normalizeChartSchema` or read the axes lowering, at `4cc8be66f`: `78 passed`.
- `check-changeset-presence`: `4 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`. `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-changeset-overwrite` are green. `check:changeset-claims`: `No pending changeset names a file this change touches`. `check:pending-changeset-literals` is green.
- `check:new-line-citations`: `0 new citation(s)`. `check:control-bytes`: `OK`. `check-doc-links`: `Links are valid across 17 scan roots`. `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:doc-fences` and `check:doc-example-readers` are green.
- `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots` and `check:spec-symbols` are green.
- eslint on the 4 touched TS files: `--format json` reports 4 files and 0 errors. The new files add no warnings, and the existing `no-explicit-any` warnings in `normalizeChartSchema.ts` predate this change. The root config is not type-aware (no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`), and no local rule reads the filesystem, so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict. The repo-wide lint run belongs to CI.
- **NOT MEASURED: `check:doc-snippets` and `check:doc-examples`.** Reason: PREREQUISITE NOT MET, because they need a 34-package scoped build. Declared narrowing: the doc diff removes one prose line outside any fence, the fenced blocks are byte-identical, and those gates read fenced blocks only. CI runs them in full.

## Acceptance notes

- The `AdvancedChartImplProps.xAxis` docblock lists `format` / `title` / `showGridLines` as the category-axis presentation. Since objectui#9675 the scatter branch has also read `min` / `max` / `stepSize` / `logarithmic` from it. The docblock was incomplete before this change and is not made false by it, and `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` is outside the claim. Noted here, not filed.
- `ChartRenderer.tsx` changed on main after the base (objectui#8086, PR 10554). The seam pin renders through it, but the changed arm is `series`, which the pin does not write. The pin was not re-run on a merge; the merge queue rebuilds on main.

## Finding, not fixed here

`xAxis.position` is declared (spec `ChartAxisSchema.position`, "Axis position", with values `left` / `right` / `top` / `bottom`, referenced on objectui's `ChartSchema.xAxis`). After this change it reaches the normalized axis, but no renderer reads it: `position: 'top'` still draws the x axis at the bottom on scatter and bar (H4 above). The docs table row "The side of the chart the axis belongs to" is its doc half.

`Seam: spec:ChartAxisSchema.position → runtime:normalizeChartSchema x-axis → renderer:AdvancedChartImpl XAxis (no orientation read)`
